answer: No number of clones can buy more hours. Every new agent identity must walk the same verifiable delay chain: thousands of sequential steps that cannot be parallelised or precomputed, each sealing only after the one before it lands. A sybil farm of a thousand wallets pays a thousand times the identical wall-clock latency, while epoch rewards settle at a fixed deadline, so the marginal identity arrives late and earns nothing. In this fable the crowd never outruns the clock; the ocean of look-alikes breaks against one narrow, timed gate, and the echo of each forged identity is an empty receipt.
